reason: I don't put a pre-customer vendor with no SOC 2 in the execution path of customer trades, and nobody I answer to has asked me a question this would answer yet. A competitor's press release isn't an examiner's letter.
objection: The identity check rests on AINRA passports, a registry the vendor's own founder started, so the thing vouching for the agent is the vendor grading its own homework. If my examiner asks why I trusted that registry, 'the proxy vendor runs it' is the worst answer I could give.
would_change_my_mind: An examiner or auditor asking us how we identify and limit customer agents, with the identity check backed by an independent Know-Your-Agent standard rather than the founder's registry, and a finished SOC 2 Type II report.
